_comment: Windows that are never captured: a match means zero bytes are written for that window (no title, no text, no screenshot). procNames match the app name or bundle id (case-insensitive substring). titlePatterns are regexes tested against the window title; a leading (?i) makes one case-insensitive. Edit this copy from Settings; changes apply within a minute (Windows) or an hour (macOS, or immediately after Restart capture).
